title: Tài trợ truyền thông công · Discuss both views
prompt: Some people support funding public broadcasters through general taxation, while others oppose it because of the risks it could create. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Commercial advertising rarely pays for every information service that a diverse public needs, particularly during emergencies. I favour stable public funding for broadcasting that serves neglected audiences, provided appointments and funding decisions are sufficiently insulated from ministers to let journalists investigate the same government that supplies their institution's money.

Supporters argue that stable public funding can support services that attract small audiences but have social value. Minority-language reporting and detailed local coverage may not generate enough advertising revenue. A broadcaster could maintain an accessible emergency-information service. Public funding can keep such services available regardless of whether their audience is commercially attractive, supporting access when information has value beyond private consumption. A tax-funded emergency service can serve audiences unattractive to advertisers, yet its public value is weakened if government ministers can directly influence what journalists choose to report.

Opponents warn that dependence on government funding can expose editorial decisions to political pressure. Politicians controlling annual funding or senior appointments may have opportunities to reward favourable coverage and punish criticism. Even without direct orders, journalists can anticipate that pressure, weakening editorial independence despite the broadcaster's formal commitment to public service. Funding could be agreed for a protected period through an independent process, and appointment criteria published, making it harder to punish an unfavourable investigation through immediate budget cuts or leadership replacement. Protected appointments and funding terms must limit opportunities for retaliation, so critical reporting does not expose the broadcaster to immediate financial punishment. Funding should be judged alongside editorial independence, accessibility and service to underserved audiences, rather than assuming that public ownership guarantees impartial journalism.

Public funding is justified where it keeps neglected services available without buying editorial loyalty; access and independence must operate together, since an extensively funded broadcaster cannot fulfil its public role if criticism threatens its financial survival.

Độc lập biên tập phụ thuộc khả năng tránh trả đũa về tiền và nhân sự, không chỉ lời hứa trung lập. steps.quote: Opponents warn that dependence on government funding can expose editorial decisions to political pressure.

exercises.question: Chọn thesis đáp ứng đủ câu hỏi và có thể bảo vệ bằng hai đoạn thân bài.
options: The issue of funding public broadcasters through general taxation is very important in modern society and has many different opinions.
I completely support funding public broadcasters through general taxation in every circumstance, regardless of its consequences.

I favour stable public funding for broadcasting that serves neglected audiences, provided appointments and funding decisions are sufficiently insulated from ministers to let journalists investigate the same government that supplies their institution's money.
exercises.explanation: Nguồn tiền công chỉ được ủng hộ cùng quyền điều tra chính bên cấp tiền. Bảo vệ bổ nhiệm và ngân sách giới hạn công cụ chi phối của bộ trưởng, thay vì giả định nhiệm vụ công tự động tạo báo chí độc lập.

exercises.question: Vì sao cần bảo vệ tài trợ và bổ nhiệm thay vì chỉ hứa không kiểm duyệt?
options: Vì chỉ đài có doanh thu quảng cáo mới chịu sức ép từ bên cấp tiền.
Vì cấp tiền nhiều hơn tự động loại bỏ mọi ảnh hưởng chính trị lên lựa chọn tin.
Vì nhà báo có thể tự tránh điều tra khi lo ngân sách hoặc lãnh đạo bị thay để trả đũa, dù chưa có mệnh lệnh cấm.
exercises.explanation: Vì nhà báo có thể tự tránh điều tra khi lo ngân sách hoặc lãnh đạo bị thay để trả đũa, dù chưa có mệnh lệnh cấm. Tự kiểm duyệt không để lại mệnh lệnh cấm rõ ràng. Theo dõi hoạt động điều tra vào lúc quyết định tài trợ nhạy cảm giúp kiểm tra sự độc lập trong thực tế, thay vì chỉ dựa vào tuyên bố rằng chưa có ai bị yêu cầu im lặng.
